main_recommendation: LOCO is the next priority for real pallet instance/domain coverage. It has explicit CC0 and reachable RGB archive plus manual target-instance boxes. It supplies neither native8 semantic reference labels nor external/self occlusion truth. Do not claim it solves the visibility goal.
important_scope: Three concrete public-source leads are separated by suitability. Only LOCO meets whole-scene realRGB + explicitdatasetlicense + availableinstanceboxes in this bounded check; Lang2Lift remains license/annotation HOLD and pallet-block32965 is a part-appearance component rather than fullpallet corpus. No second/third equallyready corpus is invented.
